title: Mixed Event — close game/OFFLINE

meta.Outline: Nene finds out there will be a gaming tournament taking place at an arcade, and decides to participate in hopes of winning the grand prize. But just around the same time, Toya is also thinking about participating...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm glad that I got a chance to play “Black Galaxy Soldier” and scored a ton of headshots, but...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I feel like this arcade doesn't care for their games as much as they really should.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Even though the buttons were sometimes buggy and slow to respond, I cut it some slack since it was close to the station... But seriously, the reticle not being aligned and calibrated for a shooter?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (On top of almost losing, I didn't get a very good score... Just stress on top of stress...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That other arcade probably doesn't have any new titles available yet, but I might go check it out...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, wait. It's not exactly in a great area. Maybe I should try somewhere else...

rows.Speaker: Man Handing Out Flyers
rows.Line: We're having our grand reopening! Please come check us out!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Th-They never give you a chance to react or refuse... I always end up taking whatever they're handing out...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I mean, shoving flyers in people's faces when they're not interested is so... Hm...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Grand Arcade Reopening!
Notice regarding the Funtastic Gaming Tournament”...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't remember another arcade being around here. But this map says it should be nearby...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Maybe it's a really small arcade.
And yet, it's holding this big gaming tournament to celebrate its grand reopening. What kind of...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A gaming tournament?! That sounds super fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I want you guys to take a look at this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
This is...
A unique flyer to say the least.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They seem to have used an old piece of software for the graphical text. This rainbow-colored lettering and overly three-dimensional look...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But look at how cute and colorful it is.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The flyer's design isn't what I want you to see. Look at what's written...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, that's right. You want to enter into this tournament.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, Nene, it's very rare of you to show any interest in an event like this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, I'm a little nervous about having to play in front of complete strangers...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But the winner of this tournament will get some VIP passes to the Gaming Expo... That's what I'm after.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
The Gaming Expo?
Oh, what's that?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's an event that's gonna happen at the convention center soon and they'll be unveiling a bunch of new games. It's one of the biggest events of the year for gamers since you get to hear directly from the devs and try out some new titles before they're released.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I had no idea!
That must mean it's an extravaganza you also really look forward to each year, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Extravaganza might be a bit much, but yes, it is important to me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Those passes also include tickets to a show that'll take place during the Expo.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right. It's a show based on a video game that I've loved since I was little, so I've desperately been wanting to see it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I had to sort of give up on it since tickets for it sold out immediately.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, the one that calls itself as being “next-generation entertainment”.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good question. Is the show they're doing at the Gaming Expo attracting that much attention...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it is. Not only are they using state-of-the-art technology, they've enlisted the help of actors, performers and a director from supposedly the best theater troupe in Japan.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The best in Japan? I see...
Now I'm interested.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna see it too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, why don't we all enter this tournament together? The grand prize is supposed to include four passes, so we'll all be able to go if we win.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, this tournament requires people to enter as pairs, so I'd really appreciate it if you guys joined...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, I see.
Video games aren't exactly my forte, so I'm not sure if I'll be of any help...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Regardless, I vow to do my best!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup!
I'm gonna try really hard too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As I. Well, that's what I'd like to say...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But the day of this tournament...
Isn't this when we're supposed to go and get that large prop for our next show?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right!
Shosuke said that he's gonna get a truck and stuff for it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's all supposed to happen in the afternoon, which is when this gaming tournament's supposed to take place...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Does that mean you guys can't enter?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sorry, I'd completely forgotten about that. I guess we don't really have a choice since our next show takes priority...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You can leave the prop pick-up to me and Rui. You and Nene can enter the tournament!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui will need to be there to check over everything while I cover the carrying duties and such. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. There isn't that much to carry this time around, so Tsukasa and I should be able to handle everything.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, because it's the perfect plan!
We'll be able to get our prop as planned and win tickets for that show you mentioned!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, we'll leave winning the tickets to you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Roger dodger!
We're guaranteed to succeed since I'll have Nene on my team!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure I can guarantee success...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But... I promise to do my best.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! We'll be rooting for you two!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Alright, I need to practice up until the tournament to raise our odds of winning...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hang on... This thing says nothing about which games we're supposed to play. Does this mean we're gonna find out the day of...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene!
Let's do our best to win☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wah! Oh, Emu...
Hehe. Yeah, let's.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, it looks like it's in a good spot. If I drop the claw here...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm nearing my limit in terms of what I can carry. Also, I may want to stop since Akito should be arriving soon.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I have two more plays...
I don't think I can get the ones in the back, but the plushies in the front seem doable.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa! What's with all the plushies?! That bag looks completely stuffed.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, these? I noticed that there were a few new claw machines, so I tried some out while I waited.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And you ended up winning this many?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (His house is gonna start overflowing with plushies if he keeps this many every time...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. I still have a couple of plays left, so if you don't mind waiting a bit.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's all good.
I'll be sitting over there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure thing. Wait, you got another one? Seriously, how do you do it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it was actually about to fall from the claw, but luckily, it ended up literally hanging by its little string.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wow...
I still don't get how you do it, but good for you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's head over to practice.
We'll warm up today at our usual spot and...

rows.Speaker: Man Handing Out Flyers
rows.Line:
It's our grand reopening!
All are welcome!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm...?
“Grand Arcade Reopening!
Notice regarding the Funtastic Gaming Tournament”...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Has there always been an arcade here? Also, what's with this design... It looks ancient...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, are you interested in this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, a little.
They seem to have some games that I've never played before.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But this gaming tournament...
What could it be...?
The day of the gaming tournament

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!
This is where the gaming tournament's gonna take place?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's bigger than I expected...
I sorta just assumed that it was a small place based on that flyer.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And it's all underground. It feels like a secret base!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, it... M-Miku?!
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe☆ This sounded like fun so I decided to join you! Mind if I stick around to watch for a bit?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure!
We can play together☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure that's gonna be possible...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But we can just have you hide once more people show up, so why don't you stay with us until then?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Still, they have so many games here!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I know this one!
You dance while staying in rhythm with the music☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I tried it a while back and got up to the highest level!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I usually play shooters and...
Well, games that involve playing against others.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
They're games where you use a gun.
There should be some around here...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What is it?
Is this game really rare or something?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Black Galaxy Soldier's a foreign title and really popular among gamers, but there aren't supposed to be that many of these machines in Japan.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I really wasn't expecting to find it here...
I thought the only arcade with it was the one by the station...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Would it be okay if I took a quick look at it...? I really wanna see what the controller's like...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, is that gun the controller?
Cool!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I wanna watch while you use it, Nene☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(The buttons are so easy to press...
And the reticle's aligned perfectly.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (As far as I can see, even the older components seem clean and well-maintained... I'm starting to like this place. And it's really close by...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks.
That gave me a good picture.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, all I did was see if this would be easier to use compared to one at this other arcade...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But despite having a game that you weren't expecting to see here, there aren't that many people here at this arcade.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
You'd think it'd be more crowded since it's so clean with so much available.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Could it be the location?
It might be hard to spot since it's underground.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Still, I'm really glad this place exists.
Less people means I can focus more.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, it's already time?!
We need to register for the competition.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sorry, Miku!
You're gonna have to hide for a bit here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Okay, have fun!
I'll be cheering for you from your pocket☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: E-Excuse me... Is this where we register for the gaming tournament?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Oh, hello...!
Does this mean you're interested?!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Alright, if you don't mind filling out this form for me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I can take care of that!
Here, here and done!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Thank you. I'm so glad that you've decided to enter. Unfortunately for us, we haven't gotten many customers...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, it is kind of unfortunate...
I mean, this arcade's so big.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe being underground really is making this place hard to find.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: That could be a factor, but some other reasons also come to mind...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: So, my grandfather used to be the manager of this arcade before he passed away, and my father, who didn't know much about video games, decided to take over...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Since he did, the games weren't maintained properly and it became difficult to bring in new titles.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: We had to start weighing our options after our sales began to plummet.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: We even reached the point of talking about shuttering this place for good, but I spoke out against it because this place means quite a lot to me and proposed that we try to start over...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: And I decided to hold a gaming tournament as a way to promote this arcade in the hopes that it'd attract more customers.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: This grand reopening is supposed to mark a new dawn for us! My hope is that you really get to enjoy yourselves today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We will! And I'll do my best to make this tournament really exciting...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I should also do my best...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can tell they take good care of all their machines just based on how the controllers look and feel...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If we want this place to stay in business, we'll need to do our best today to make this tournament a good one.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa, there's way more people here now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, there are... But I'm seeing a lot of elderly people and women who seem to be homemakers... Not exactly what you'd call gamers...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, the manager said that they tried reaching out to everyone in the neighborhood for this tournament!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The more the merrier☆
It's more fun that way, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
R-Right...
At the same time, I'm getting kinda nervous about playing in front of all these people...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for gathering here today! We will now be kicking off our Funtastic Gaming Tournament!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is gonna be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Let's get started by introducing the four teams that will be participating today!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait, we have to go up on stage...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(There's less people than I thought...
I might be okay if the crowd stays around this size.)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: First up... The Wonderhoy Button Mashers!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Hang on, Emu, when did you come up with this team name?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's what I wrote on that form during registration for the part that said, “Team Name.” And I came up with this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's cute, right?! Video games are all about pressing lots of buttons, right☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure “cute” is the right word... It seems kinda dorky, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Our next team is We're The Best, followed by Muscles Are Everything...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
And finally, we have...
Willow & Cloud!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What do you think it means?
It's a little different from the other team names, so what kind of people do you think are...?
We're looking forward to competing today!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That looks like the split-personality guy and... Aoyagi?! What are they doing here...?!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Wh-What are they doing here...?!
They don't seem like the gaming type...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Th-This might get awkward...
I'd prefer it if they didn't recognize me...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? Hey, they seem really familiar...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Tsukasa's friends!
Right, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? E-Emu, wait!
Not so loud...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, wait...
Aren't you in Tsukasa and Rui's troupe? Don't you guys do shows together...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm Emu Otori!
It's really nice to meet you☆

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Nice to meet you. My name is Toya Aoyagi. I've had the pleasure of knowing Tsukasa since we were both very little.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nice to meet you. I'm Akito Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? Something seems different. I could've sworn that you were smiling while greeting us just now, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's sorta just the way he is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, Kusanagi, I wasn't expecting to see you at this tournament. Do you like playing video games as well?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, there's that...
But I also want to win the tickets that are included as the prize.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Interesting.
As it so happens, we're also after those tickets.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, because there's a famous team performing at that event, and it's always very hard to get tickets to see them. They'll be performing on the main stage it seems.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They're top-line performers, so we want to see what kind of show they put on.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right...
Because you and your team also sing and perform.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, this means we'll have to compete against each other for those tickets...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it does. Let's both do our very best.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Okay, that's all of our participants!
Next, allow me to explain the rules for this tournament!

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line:
The other teams look pretty weak.
Just what you'd expect from an arcade that no one goes to.

rows.Speaker: We're The Best B
rows.Line: Yeah, and we probably won't have to do “the thing”...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: We've prepared three games for this tournament and your team will earn points based on where it ranks for each one.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: The team with the most amount of points in the end will be declared the winner!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That makes sense.
Simply put, winning is the best way to earn points.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. We still don't know which games they're gonna throw at us, but we just gotta do what we can to win.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's all about to begin, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, we gotta do our best...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Also, three games...
The question's gonna be which ones...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But this is a gaming tournament, so I've gotta think they'll have us play something that involves PvP. That means we have a decent shot at winning, especially if fighting games or shooters are chosen...)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: We will now be announcing the games that will be played during this tournament! Our first title is...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay, this is gonna be great!
And super fun!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Um, excuse me...
Can I ask a question?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You just said, “Print Stickers”...
Are you talking about those booths where you take pictures and draw all over them?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Yes, exactly! They're all the rage primarily amongst high school girls because of how you're able to edit your own pictures by giving yourselves larger eyes and such!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Does this mean there's also some sort of player-versus-player function built in...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Dude, there's no way...
At least, I don't think so...

rows.Speaker: Muscles Are Everything A
rows.Line: H-How are we supposed to compete using pictures...?

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line: It's not even a video game!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(They're right...
I'm having a hard time wrapping my head around this one...)

rows.Speaker: Homemakers in the Audience
rows.Line:
Oh, Print Stickers.
I remember those. We used to do them all the time.

rows.Speaker: Homemakers in the Audience
rows.Line: Same here. I remember customizing my student ID holder and trading stickers with my friends. Back then, you didn't have many background options...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-They're not bothered by this at all...?!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I'm sure many of you are surprised, but I'd like all of you to try out as many different things in this arcade as possible during this tournament!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Furthermore, this arcade has booths where even male patrons can feel right at home, so please be sure to check them out!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now I get it. It's a way to promote the arcade as a whole albeit a bit crude...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for giving us a full rundown. Now, how exactly are we supposed to compete against one another?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: The team that takes the picture with the most “likes” from the judges will be declared the winner.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: The judges include three members ranging from a high school girl to a homemaker with seemingly different tastes.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
It will be your job as participants to take pictures that make them think, “Oh, I like that!”
Again, the team with the most points will be the winner.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo! Print Stickers! It's been ages!
Let's go, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Look at that!
The Wonderhoy Button Mashers are already headed towards one of the booths!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
This isn't exactly my thing, but I guess we don't have a choice...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
The thing is... I've never made any Print Stickers before...
Do you think we still stand a chance...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, don't let that bother you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't have much experience with this stuff either. I mean, I don't know anything about editing pictures or making them more buzz-worthy...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right...
Then, winning the first round may be difficult for us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I know it's just a game, but Toya's been looking forward to this tournament because we'd get a chance to play a bunch of different stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (So, on top of wanting those tickets, I want him to win.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's just give it our best shot...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! Look at all the lights!
Everything's so bright and sparkly!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Ugh... So bright...
They're brighter than stage lights...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Wow, you're right!
You get to take pictures in here?!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I couldn't help it. This looks like so much fun☆ Plus, no one will see me here!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You're gonna take some pictures in here, right? Have you decided on a pose and stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... How about something like this☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? I don't think I can get myself to do that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But we don't get many chances to do stuff like this. We should just go all out and strike a really fun pose!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<What she said!
I bet everyone will pick you guys' picture if you decide to be bold and do something really cute☆>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It might even help later on when you need to strike a cute pose during a show!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is gonna be really embarrassing, but I should probably do as they say...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow!
The lights made our eyes so sparkly!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-No, this is way too embarrassing...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Don't say that!
You're totally gonna win with this picture☆>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, I wanna show this to everybody in SEKAI♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, we should show it to Tsukasa and the others too! I wanna give a copy to everyone☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, you're really okay with this kind of picture? I mean, this is a competition. Should we think about how the judges are gonna react?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Then, what kind of picture should you take?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... Some way that'll make everyone who sees our picture smile...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, what about that thing you guys always do when you want everybody to smile?>

rows.Line: I'm just impressed with you is all, Akito. You seem to have some talent for choosing poses and pasting stickers onto these pictures.

rows.Line: All I could come up with was writing my own name on it. If we went with that, it's likely that it would've ended up looking like some sort of student ID.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I really don't think I did anything praiseworthy... I mean, this isn't something I want to be proud of being good at...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, don't tell anyone about this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Why not?
It turned out very well, so I think we should show...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's nothing...
I thought I heard some people shouting together just now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's probably just one of the other teams taking their picture, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, it's done printing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wouldn't worry. At the very least, I believe this is the best photo we could've taken, so let's just turn in what we have.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe☆
We're all smiles in our picture!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And yet, I feel exhausted for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're supposed to turn it in here, right...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thanks to you, Akito, our entry turned out very well. I'm sure we'll do fine.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Alright, it looks like our participants have finished taking their pictures. Once you've decided on which to turn in, please get ready to comment on why you chose it and how you designed it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So, we need to explain what we did...?
This is going to be my first time doing anything like this. I hope it goes okay...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Okay, let's begin with Muscles Are Everything!

rows.Speaker: Muscles Are Everything A
rows.Line:
That's us!
As you can see, we're all about muscles, so we went with a “brawn is beautiful” approach! I think our biceps turned out great!

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line: We didn't focus on anything in particular. They had these stamps of this game we like, so we decided to keep things simple and just go with those...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow!
Everybody's entries look so different and wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, they're all unique in their own way... Maybe a little too unique, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much!
Next, Wonderhoy Button Mashers, you have the floor!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that's us!
We went with our “wonderhoy” pose because we thought it would make you all smile!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The background and doodles we drew were also a part of that! We want everyone to smile and have lots and lots of fun!

rows.Speaker: High-Schooler Judge
rows.Line: Hey, I've seen people do this pose for one of the shows at PXL! And this doodle of Phenny's so adorable!

rows.Speaker: Homemaker Judge
rows.Line: You can tell they're having fun just by looking at their photo. It reminds me of when my husband and I went to Phoenix Wonderland for a date...

rows.Speaker: Businessman Judge
rows.Line: Yes, they're having plenty of fun, but there's a little bit too much going on here for my taste...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
That man isn't really smiling...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But everybody else appears to like it. That woman in particular can't seem to contain her smile...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still, having them all look at a picture of me's so embarrassing...)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Looks like the judges are pleased!
Last but not least, Willow & Cloud, if you will!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, so...
For our entry, we tried going with something that's trending right now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Look, they're going, “RAWR”☆
That's really cute! And super cool!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Don't worry, Akito. I'm sure we'll win. After all, your sister and Akiyama said that this pose is “in” right now...

rows.Speaker: High-Schooler Judge
rows.Line: Yeah, this “RAWR” pose's trending on PicShare right now, but it feels like a bit much to try and use it here...

rows.Speaker: Homemaker Judge
rows.Line:
Oh? I see no problem with it.
They did a special on it during this program I always watch called “Princess's Breakfast”, so it feel really trendy.

rows.Speaker: Businessman Judge
rows.Line:
I'm inclined to agree!
It takes courage for men to do anything like this. Not only that, they added some cool touches that even make me want to try it.

rows.Speaker: Businessman Judge
rows.Line: I must commend you for giving me the courage to keep trying and not give up! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting any of those kinds of reactions...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But those two seemed to genuinely like it. That should put us fairly high up, yes?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Okay, now that we've heard from the judges, let's move on to the results!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Our three judges will now each write the name of the team that they believed submitted the best entry!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, it is.
I hope we did okay...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Alright, judges, we'll start from the left!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
I'm so glad that they noticed our hidden Phenny too♪

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Okay, let's see what our next judge wrote. He chose...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We're not out of the woods yet, but it's a good sign.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But to think we're neck-and-neck with Kusanagi's team...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Another team can still earn a vote, and if those guys get it... We need to get in the lead as soon as we can since we don't know what's coming down the pike...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I really hope we win, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Alright, onto our final judge.
Let's see who she chose!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We did it!
Nene, this is so wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We did what we could, so oh well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. We can take the lead during the next round.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Plus, I learned why Print Stickers are so much fun. Let's try using different frames and stamps next time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry, but you're gonna have to ask someone else...

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line:
Hey, what's up with this tournament...!
We can't do “the thing” with Print Stickers!

rows.Speaker: We're The Best B
rows.Line:
Let's just calm down.
It's just the first round. We can let this one go and focus on winning the next two. How's that sound?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(What do they mean by “the thing”...?
They've been going on about it for some time now.)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Okay, we certainly have a fun competition on our hands now! Let's move on to the next round!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, what's next?!
I can't wait to see!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have to think we're not gonna get another curveball like Print Stickers...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Alright, here it is!
For the second round, you'll all be playing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Akito, we get to play Puyo Puyo!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Perfect! Puzzle games are right up your alley, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I have a good feeling about this since I play it so often. Let's get the win we need this round.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Awesome! I've played Puyo Puyo with Shosuke before! It always feels amazing when you get to pop a bunch at once!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A falling block puzzle game, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's not my best genre, but I'll just have to try my best...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: For this second round, we will be having a Puyo Puyo tournament!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Each team member will play on their own and the winning team will be determined based on total wins and losses. In the event there is a tie, the winner will be the team that scored the most points.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah...
We're playing as individuals this time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which team do you think we're gonna play against first?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Here are the matchups!!
First up, we have...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, we're playing against Toya's team?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. After the previous round, we're leading in terms of points with Aoyagi's team right behind us...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Which means...
This is a battle for the title between us, the Wonderhoy Button Mashers, and Toya's team, Willow & Cloud!

rows.Line: Alright, we have the Wonderhoy Button Mashers against Willow & Cloud! Who do you think is going to win?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I don't actually know how good Aoyagi and Shinonome are at video games...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I bumped into them in front of an arcade this one time but I've never heard him ever talk about playing video games...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, in the event Emu loses, I should still be able to cover for her... Which means we should be able to secure a win here.)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Okay, let's hear from each team about how they feel going into this round!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, oh!
I'm all smiles and ready to go☆

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: It's wonderful to see that you're so excited! Next, let's hear from Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I promise to do my best while playing fair and square.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wh-Why's he acting so different now?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I was worried about this gaming tournament possibly getting the best of him since it isn't like the events we usually do... But well done, Akito.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (They entered this tournament because they also want to win the prize. They don't really seem like the gaming type.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm not much of a gamer either, but I did practice a bit to prepare for this...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Including playing some Puyo Puyo...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Alright, just stay calm.
Look at the Puyo that's coming down and the color of the next one...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Here we...!!
Go, go, go, go, go!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Oh, Otori from the Wonderhoy Button Mashers is dropping Puyos so quickly that no one can see what's going on!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She mentioned that she'd played this with Shosuke before, but she's setting up chains like a pro...! Way to go, Emu...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We might just have this in the bag...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Grr... You've gotta be kidding me...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(No, I'll be fine.
Just clear away the Garbage Puyos one by one...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Wait, she's sorta settled down after that initial burst...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Alright, I should take this opportunity to build some chains...)

rows.Line: Akito, you should be building longer chains. You won't be able to send over many Garbage Puyos by just going for two at a time.

rows.Line: I know, but I'm having trouble getting the chains I want...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But this worked during practice, so I should be okay.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Shinonome seems like the slow and steady type. I really wasn't expecting him to play like this...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (However, that's not how you win in PvP battles. I mean, the best part about Puyo Puyo is...)

rows.Line: I don't understand. Aren't you supposed to line up as many balls of the same color in the game? That girl just seems to be blindly stacking them up.

rows.Line: Oh, don't you know that it's actually not a good idea to pop them one by one? Based on what she's doing, this show's just getting started...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Everything's in place...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Here comes the big one!
Fire!

rows.Line:
Wow!
Otori's going for a massive chain!
How many is that?! Three, four... It's still going!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, you need to negate this by popping some big chains.

rows.Line: Negate this?! I can't build chains that fast!

rows.Line:
What?!
My screen's almost completely filled up!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hurry. You need to get rid of these as quickly as you can.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That's easier said than done.
I have almost no space to work with on my screen!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Akito, calm down.
Nothing will come of spinning Puyos around so fast.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, what else am I supposed to...?! Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: The first match goes to Otori of the Wonderhoy Button Mashers! Talk about winning with style!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I wasn't expecting Otori to be so good either.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But we'll get the next one.
Just leave it to me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay! I won!
Puyo Puyo's so much fun☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Nice work, Emu.
I didn't realize you were so good at this game.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Shosuke and I played a lot because he'd always ask for a rematch whenever I won!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, Nene, good luck with the next match!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right.
We need to capitalize on this chance and expand our lead.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Alright, let's move to our second match! We have Kusanagi from the Wonderhoy Button Mashers versus Aoyagi from Willow & Cloud!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Aoyagi's player ID...
Why does it seem so familiar?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I remember seeing someone with a similar name in the rankings for something before... Anyway I need to focus on this match.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Puyo Puyo's all about getting big chains, so I need to build up a good foundation as fast as possible while not making any mistakes...)

rows.Line: K-Kusanagi's building faster than her teammate, Otori, was just a moment ago...

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I-I've gotta find a way to do something about this...! If I get hit with a huge chain now, I'm...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Yes! I'm getting what I need...!

rows.Line: H-Hey, Toya, what are you doing letting go of the controls?

rows.Line: That's because all I can do now is wait...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Whoa! Here comes a huge chain!
4, 5, 6... No, it just keeps going!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I-I've never seen anything like this before...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is bad! I've gotta deal with this by getting my own chain out ASAP...!)

rows.Line: There's a Star Garbage Puyo waiting to drop... If she doesn't find a way to get rid of it, then she's...

rows.Line: (I'm slowly chipping away at it, but...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, I'm not gonna make it in time...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh nooo!
It's raining Garbage Puyos!

rows.Line: That's it for Kusanagi from the Wonderhoy Button Mashers! Aoyagi from Willow & Cloud wins!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
I was worried that she'd be able to clear it away, but I'm glad it ended up working.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That's one win and one loss.
How do we deal with ties again?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, in case there's a tie, the manager said that the team with the highest number of points in total wins!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That means this one goes to...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
The winner of the second match...
The one that will advance to the finals is...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I shouldn't have let my guard down...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Seriously, a 9-chain...
There's no way a beginner can pull that off...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, Toya isn't exactly a novice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What do you mean?!
Are you a Puyo Puyo pro, Toya?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm not a professional, but I do like playing these kinds of falling block puzzle games at the arcade by the station.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wait, I knew I'd seen that player ID somewhere before...! It's #1 in the rankings for a bunch of games like this...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That makes Nene and Toya arcade buddies! She goes to that arcade a lot too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: E-Emu, you didn't have to say...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You like video games too, Kusanagi?
That explains why you're so good.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I-I'm not that good.
I mean, you clobbered me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I disagree. Not many players can hold on after being hit with a chain like that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks...
But that doesn't change the fact that I lost.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Let's have a rematch in the future.
I want to get rid of this sour taste somehow...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that sounds good.
We can play again when we're both free.

rows.Speaker: Muscles Are Everything A
rows.Line:
Hey, quit playing dirty!
Where's your sportsmanship!

rows.Speaker: Muscles Are Everything B
rows.Line: These guys deliberately bumped me during the match! Isn't that an infraction or something?!

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line: Don't make up excuses just because you lost. Also, do you have any proof?

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line:
The other teams look pretty weak.
Just what you'd expect from an arcade that no one goes to.

rows.Speaker: We're The Best B
rows.Line: Yeah, and we probably won't have to do “the thing”...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They seem to be having a big argument about something.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That guy's saying his opponent cheated somehow, but it's kinda hard to tell who's telling the truth if there's no evidence of anything happening...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I'm sorry. We didn't see anything on the security footage...

rows.Speaker: Muscles Are Everything A
rows.Line:
So we have to take a loss?!
There's no way that's fair...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Their match didn't seem to go very smoothly it seems.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Aren't video games supposed to be about everyone having fun...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's not like we saw anything, so it's hard to say whether or not any cheating did occur...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But if the match goes to them, doesn't that mean you guys are gonna be facing them next, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
We'll be careful.
Let's hope this was all just a big misunderstanding.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Okay, for our final Puyo Puyo match we have We're The Best versus Willow & Cloud!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Where did all these people come from...?
The manager said that they only asked everyone in the neighborhood to come see this, but I'm seeing way more young people here now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I overheard some of the people in the audience saying how everyone's talking about this tournament online! That might be why so many people are here now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I didn't realize that.
But I did see some people taking pictures and videos. Plus, there's also Aoyagi's turn to look forward to after this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It'd be great if things became even more fun and exciting!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (All the more reason I'm hoping nothing serious happens...)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Teams, if you'll send out your players for the first match!

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm playing against that guy.
Lucky for me, I drew the beginner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
Just try to stay calm.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Th-That guy from the other team's really good...! Did they really cheat just now? There's kind of no point if they're this strong...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Shinonome's gonna be in for a tough one if this keeps up...)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
What's this?!
Shinonome of Willow & Cloud has somehow managed to make quick work of the Garbage Puyos from that 3-chain he received just now!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You've improved quite a bit since the last match. You may have the potential to surpass even me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:

Luck was the reason I was able to deal with those Garbage Puyos just now.

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line: Alright, it's time to end it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Grr... No, I'm not gonna make it!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: And that's an “Oh no...” for Shinonome! The first game goes to We're The Best!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh no!
Akito was doing so well too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He put up a good fight...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, you did very well.
You can leave the rest to me.

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That was close. For a second there, I thought I was in trouble.

rows.Speaker: We're The Best B
rows.Line: Luckily, you didn't have to do “the thing”. But we still have to deal with that guy...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Alright, it's the moment of truth! This match will determine the winner of the Puyo Puyo portion of our tournament!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
This is it! The final battle...
Let's get it started!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Geez, he's so fast...!
I'm sensing no hesitation either. He's dropping Puyos with so much precision.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
This is so cool!
They're going all, “Drop, drop, drop!” and “Pop, pop, pop!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Toya seems to be doing okay...
At this pace, he should be able to wrap things up pretty soon. The only problem is...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Looks like they're about to make their move...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Um, excuse me...

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line: I was hoping to get a look at how he does what he does. You know, for future reference? Unfortunately, my vision isn't very good, so I have to watch fairly up close.

rows.Line: I'm sorry, but I can't let you break his concentration. Why don't I take a video for you to watch later instead?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hm? Shinonome and that other guy seem to be arguing about something... What's that guy's team up to...?)

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line: Gah. I don't have a choice...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! He accidentally spilled his drink!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, that wasn't an accident...

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line:
S-Sorry about that!
I guess I got too caught up in the action...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Akito.
It'll be over shortly...

rows.Speaker: We're The Best B
rows.Line:
What?!
W-Wait, a Crown Garbage Puyo?!
No, I don't have time to deal with it...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
A-And the winner is...
Willow & Cloud with their two marvelous victories...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That was awesome!
He got a 13-chain!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
As for you two, a word.
I can't let what you just did slide.

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line: H-Hold on a second. We're sorry for disrupting the game like that, but it was an accident, honest!

rows.Speaker: We're The Best B
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Besides, we lost. If we wanted to win, we would've interfered sooner!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, it's okay since I ultimately won.
Let's continue the tournament.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, because I'd rather not have this tournament ruined in such a manner.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
If you, the victim, are okay with this...
Regardless, your team's on notice now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Aoyagi let them off, but I still think they did that on purpose...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Why would they do such a thing?
All the manager wanted to do was put on a fun and exciting gaming tournament that everyone could enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, she's right. This arcade means a lot to the manager and this tournament's meant to increase its appeal. And the rest of us are trying our best while...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Those jerks... They nearly ruined everything. I can't forgive them for what they tried to pull...)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Alright, we've reached the final round of this tournament. To cap things off, we have something special in store for all of you... The next-gen first-person survival game that's all the rage right now!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Now, let's take a quick look at the standings.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: In first place, we have Willow & Cloud, followed by the Wonderhoy Button Mashers, We're The Best and Muscles Are Everything!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: However, as it stands, this round will end up being a one-on-one showdown between the top two teams... Which is why we will be adding in some special rules to give the bottom two teams a fighting chance!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: The team that survives until the very end will receive... Double the usual points! Yes, double! This is still anybody's tournament!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This kind of stuff's pretty standard, but isn't double a bit crude?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, this might be our chance...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
And it's like Emu said...
Video games are all about people having fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Which is why...
We've gotta use this game to send that message to those guys.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Was it because Toya was so amazing at Puyo Puyo? There's so many people here now☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The manager's probably really happy too, and we should do our best to make the last round an exciting one!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can't help but feel nervous knowing that all these people are watching... But if we're playing the game that I think we're gonna play for the last round, it'll be in my best genre...!)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Okay, it's the moment you've all been waiting for! And it looks like we have a great crowd here now! We will now be unveiling the game that will be played during the final round! You will be playing...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
“Field Battle”!
The next-gen first-person survival game that's become a massive hit!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Nene, does that mean you've played it before?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I really like it and I've been playing it a lot recently.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You form teams of two and battle for survival in this big, open wasteland. You're free to work with others or stab them in the back, and up to fifty teams can play.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Fifty teams?!
You can have that many people playing all at once?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I suspect we'll be playing on a smaller field to match the size of this tournament, but I'm liking our chances since we get to play Field Battle.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa!
You really think we'll be able to zoom into the lead?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Also, Nene!
I've never played this game before, so can you teach me what you know?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll teach you what I can since this game's all about having good teamwork.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: However, you can get double the points for surviving until the end... That might give the other teams that were out of the running enough motivation to really fight...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, finding a place to hide is gonna take priority. Also, make sure to crouch when you see an opponent to make sure they don't see you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Roger!
Private Emu's ready and willing to follow the great Captain Nene wherever she goes!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, okay. You don't have to call me “Captain” or anything.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is probably gonna be a tougher battle than I initially imagined, but I have experience on my side. We'll be fine as long as we stay calm and...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, we're playing Field Battle next...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're not too great at these kinds of games, right, Toya? That means avoiding fights might be the best way for us to survive.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree.
I can't say much about our chances, but we'll just have to do our best.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: This game seems like the perfect way to cap off our tournament and determine the winner. So, it's time for this fight for survival to...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: First, we need to find ourselves some weapons...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene!
I found a mushroom!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? Emu, don't pick that up.
You don't wanna know what happens if you do...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes, really... Oh, I found a gun.
Here, try picking it up and equipping it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Once you do, you should be able to defend yourself. If you see any enemies, shoot.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Got it! Wow, this is so cool! It's so big!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, we'll probably come across a few more weapons, so it'll be good to try some out and see which suits you best.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Copy that!
I'll stick with this for now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm not hearing anyone else making footsteps... As far as I can tell, we're the only ones that spawned in this area.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We should start by taking a quick look around and finding some ammo, health packs and whatever else we need before hunting down our opponents.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Toya, I've equipped my gun.
How are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm set as well.
I even found some health packs and painkillers. We should be more than prepared for battle now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Nice one, Akito...
You landed a headshot.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess these kinds of games suit me more than Puyo Puyo.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I think that was one of the guys from Muscles Are Everything...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and if we find and deal with the other, their team will be eliminated.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right. One being here has to mean that the other is somewhere close by. We need to find them before they run away.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Understood.
I'll cover your back, but please move carefully.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Okay, we've picked up pretty much everything this area has to offer. Now, we need to get ready for a firefight and...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
Did someone shoot their gun just now...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa...! So that's how you shoot guns!
This is so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
E-Emu...?!
Don't fire all willy-nilly like that. You'll blow our cover...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, please! Stop!
Time out! Time out! Let's be friends!

rows.Speaker: Muscles Are Everything A
rows.Line: Grr... I can't hit her... She's bunny hopping too much...! I thought I could make quick work of her too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-That's incredible... She's dodging everything by bunny hopping...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But this also might be our chance.
Emu, hang in there! Just keep doing that for a little bit longer...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(That guy's still focused on Emu.
If I aim at him from behind...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
You're safe now. I took care of that guy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's amazing!!
I'm gonna follow you forever and ever, Captain Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, you.
Anyway, you need to reload while you can.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, Emu, please don't fire unnecessarily like that again. You're only gonna put yourself in harm's way.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I'm so sorry! I promise to be more careful!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, as long as you understand.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, it looked like that team split up to ambush the other ones. Fortunately for us, their plan fell apart.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
Looks like someone just took down the other person. I guess Muscles Are Everything are out of the game now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Us, Toya's team and...
Oh, We're The Best!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay...
There's no need to pull any punches from here on out.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The real battle's about to begin, Emu, so get ready to fight.

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line:
So those two teams are still alive...
If we win here we should be able to claim victory for the tournament since we're technically in second right now.

rows.Speaker: We're The Best B
rows.Line:
Yeah.
And lucky for us, they chose this game for the last round. If we do “the thing”...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, Nene, you were so close!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is bad. We're like fish in a barrel here...! We need to get out of this smoke screen fast...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It's okay, Emu.
If we can crawl out of this smoke somehow...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You helped us?
But we're supposed to be fighting against each other.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, but I didn't feel good about seeing somebody I know get shot.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're saying that now?
We're supposed to find a way to survive here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I know...
But this game just might not be for me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think you're a little too nice, but... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: We're The Best B
rows.Line:
Grr...!
They're pretty good, so you need to be careful!

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line: Yeah, if only I had that one item! Then I could end this thing in a flash!

rows.Speaker: We're The Best B
rows.Line: Still, it's been a while since we've had to play so hard...

rows.Speaker: We're The Best B
rows.Line:
I think I've gotten worse...
We used to play every single day with the others too.

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah.
It's been so long since we've gotten a chance to play some video games like this. Now I just need to avenge you and...

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line:
Wait, no! What are we saying?!
We're not here to have fun! We're here to win by any means necessary!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
What's this...?
He's using a mushroom?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What's so scary about a mushroom? I saw a ton growing on the side of the road... What possible use can they have?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Normally, they're completely useless. The developers put them in because they felt like it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
H-Huh?! Why?!
It says that I'm dead even though I haven't been hit!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wait, me too...!
What's going on here?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu and Shinonome didn't make it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's an exploit that involved using those mushrooms. Combined with a certain set of actions, it causes players in close proximity to be deemed ineligible to keep playing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The bug causing it was discovered just recently and they've announced that it's now a banned practice while they work on a patch for it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, players are banned from using this exploit during a game?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They really plan on winning by whatever means necessary.

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line:
Uh oh...
I'm not sure what happened, but seems like some players collapsed after I used this mushroom.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Even though you clearly did it on purpose...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I can't let this one go.
Kusanagi, I have a plan...

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
The Puyo Puyo master's one thing, but that girl's gonna be a pain to deal with... She definitely knew about that exploit...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Good try, Kusanagi.
A few millimeters to the side and you would've gotten a headshot.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That was nothing.
More importantly, we need to take this opportunity to pincer that guy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. However, I still don't feel that great about shooting someone...

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line:
Ugh! I had them...!
But I'm not about to lose here!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-That guy's probably gonna cheat again...! I've gotta get rid of him before he gets a chance to...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh?! What happened?
Where did he...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What...?!
He just appeared out of thin air! Is this another exploit...?! How many does this guy know about?!

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line: Once you're out of the picture, victory will be...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? What the? Did he just throw a pot lid?

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line:
Ugh...!
No, I'm not about to lose yet. Not before I take you down!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I can't see at all...
At this rate, Aoyagi's gonna...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, I'd be putting myself in danger by moving... It's probably best for me to wait for their fight to resolve and shoot whoever's left, but...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That guy attacked Aoyagi after he tried to save me.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to do the same for him...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Aoyagi, do you know where that guy is right now...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Over here, Kusanagi!
He's got me pinned down!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which means his head should be... There!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Well done, Kusanagi.
That was a nice shot.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That should be all of them, right...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our alliance may've been short-lived, but it was fun. I even had the pleasure of seeing just how strong you are, Kusanagi. Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I won't be going easy on you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Me neither.
I'm here to win, so I'm going all out.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: O-Okay, we have quite the game on our hands here! The winner of this final showdown will be the victor of this tournament! Let's see who the goddess of victory smiles upon today...!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: It doesn't matter who wins! This is gonna be a great showdown!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(It's up to me to get those tickets...
I'm here because I want to go see that show with everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(It's finally over...
That turned out to be a really good tournament.)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
This tournament was off the hook!
I wish I was here from the start!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah, that showdown in the end was awesome too! I had no idea that a pot could deflect bullets like that, and that girl was such a good shot.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Also, I didn't realize that there was an arcade here. I might start coming here more often since it has so much to offer.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It looks like the manager's wish came true. I'm really glad.)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Okay, let me get this straight.
You two decided to cheat to win because of the tickets that were up on offer as the prize?

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line: With those VIP passes, we would've been guaranteed a chance to play this new PvP game ahead of its release. Normally, we'd have to draw straws for spots...

rows.Speaker: We're The Best B
rows.Line: We wanted to play it before anybody else...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I understand how you guys feel, but that doesn't make it okay to cheat...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, video games are all about people having fun, right? If one person cheats, it sorta ruins it for everyone else...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
I agree...
We all experience moments when we have trouble winning or clearing a stage.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: However, isn't there fun in figuring out an honest way to overcome said challenge?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I believe that's what really makes video games so enjoyable. As gamers, you did something rather disgraceful.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In my case, I may be good at Puyo Puyo, but I didn't feel too confident about the last game we played since it's not a genre I'm very familiar with and couldn't move around all that well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Regardless, I had fun during the last round. That includes both the showdown I had with Kusanagi and our skirmish against you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I would've been ecstatic if I'd somehow found a way to come out on top without cheating after being thrown into that sort of 2-vs-1 situation.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Even someone like me probably would've felt a little proud of figuring out a solution all on my own...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The point is, it's just more fun to succeed under your own power, right...?

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line:
You guys are right...
At some point, we'd completely forgotten about what makes video games fun.

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I promise to never do anything like this again. I'll play fair and square next time.

rows.Speaker: We're The Best B
rows.Line:
I'm sorry too...
Sir, I apologize for all the trouble we caused.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
As long as you understand...
Based on what I saw during the last round, it's clear that you two genuinely love video games and have a deep knowledge of them.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: So, you'll always be welcome here as long as that love persists. Come back whenever you like...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's great!
Let's all have fun while playing something together next time!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Now then. I believe it's about time the winners of this tournament received their reward...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. We did it!
This means we get to see that show together!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's too bad. We got pretty far too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, but we have to accept the fact that we lost and give up on seeing that team's performance.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sure we'll get a chance to see them someday.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That's right. They also really wanted to win these tickets.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... Isn't there some way for us to split these tickets?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Don't mind us and enjoy yourselves. Your team won them fair and square.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Why don't I give your team my VIP passes, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: So, this person who knows a lot about the industry gave me four passes as a way to see what's trending or going on right now. But I'd much prefer it if you went to see that performance instead.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But if we take them, you won't be able to...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Don't mind me.
I'm sure I'll get another chance in the future if I stay in this line of work. More importantly, you helped make this day absolutely unforgettable.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Yes. To see my grandfather's store filled with customers, and to see them all smiling... I never thought such a day would ever come.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I have all of you to thank for that, so please, take these as a small token of my appreciation.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
We appreciate your offer greatly and will gladly use them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I feel kinda bad about receiving the same gift as the winners of this tournament...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: In that case, I'll additionally award our winners some one-year all-you-can-play passes!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-No way...
Are you really sure about this...?!
Does that include new titles...?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
Please feel free to play any new titles as well as any that are released in the future. Just give me a shout and I'll power them up.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
I might start coming here every day! There are just so many games that I wanna try out!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um, Aoyagi.
I'm gonna practice playing Puyo Puyo a ton, so I want us to have a rematch someday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
I had fun today. I'll be looking forward to our rematch, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, this is so great!
I can't wait to see you two play again!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I kinda want to see that too.
Let me know when it happens, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sure.
We should also play again sometime, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Akito, that means we get to have a rematch too! Get ready to lose again!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it's not like me to leave things as is after losing to someone...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm gonna start getting ready to head home.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm sorry that we didn't get to talk much. You went out of your way to see us, but there so much stuff happened and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<No, that's okay☆
Especially since I got to see you kick so much butt.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. You seemed to have a lot of fun too☆ I could tell that you really love playing video games!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When I was all alone and too scared of doing shows, video games were sort of what kept me going...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Back then, I played so much that I'd sometimes put myself down by saying, “Quit running! Get a grip on reality!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I had a lot of fun today, and I'm really glad that everybody was smiling in the end.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa and the others said that they're done moving that prop and are gonna head over here! We can show them our Print Stickers☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, our... N-No, that won't be necessary!
